description: Loading skeleton for the demo app before its client store hydrates. A polite status region holding an sr-only label and Skeleton shapes (a title pill, stat tiles, panels). The shapes have no role or name; only the label is announced.

announcements: Announces the label politely, e.g. "Loading the demo…".
screenReader.notes: When the real content replaces the skeleton, the status region unmounts; the new content is not announced, which is the expected behaviour for a page load.

contrast.text: N/A; the only text is sr-only.
contrast.ui: Skeleton shapes use bg-muted; they are decorative and transient, so 3:1 does not apply.

motion.reducedMotion: The Skeleton pulse is always on. Override it with motion-reduce:animate-none in your theme if you need strict reduced-motion compliance.

consumerResponsibilities: Pick stats and panels (or pass children) to roughly match the screen that loads, so the layout doesn't jump.
Render it inside the app's content container; it brings no max width or padding of its own.
